bundle_rationale:
Backend service in isolation: no UI, no frontend assets, no operational
concerns are in scope for this work. Use when the user is iterating on
an API or service that frontend / mobile / third-party consumers will
integrate against later. Designer specialist is skipped under this
bundle because there is no UI to design; DevOps concerns are out of
scope until the user opts in by escalating scope mid-run.
